paragraphs: The early Rav Ashi, in Rav’s time. Chiyya bar Abba: three things Ashi told me from Yehoshua ben Levi, Shabbat 75b. Rav Yehudah from Ashi, Nedarim 51b; in Rav’s name, Sotah 30a. Chanina told him, “You live north of the Land,” Babylonia being north, Bava Batra 25b. R. Ch. [probably Rabbi Chanina] reports in Ashi’s name, Gittin 39, end of b. There Ashi reports in Rabbi’s name. Ashi also reports in Rabbi Shabbatai’s name (see there). Huna asked Ashi, Shabbat 60b; Ashi before Huna, Shabbat 37, end of b; Bava Kamma 114, beginning of a. Huna objected to Ashi, Avodah Zarah 60, end of b. His son Chiyya, Rav’s student. Chisda in Ashi’s name, Jerusalem Shabbat 1:1.
